says: In today's version, a summon interrupted just after its keep leaves the name kept and listed, but its `summoned` log line and its `record("summon")` row are never written.
proof: manager.ts:675 keeps the name on an interrupt when `live.get(name)?.scope === own`; the log and the record are at lines 686 to 709, after the acquireUseRelease, which an interrupted call never reaches. Main has the same window between `put` and `record`.
cost: A kept name's turns have no summon row saying what model, effort and person it was summoned with.
